page.overview:
Who is Aryssha Starros?

Aryssha Starros was a human female who was the cousin of the smuggler Sana Starros and daughter of the artist At some point she married the Imperial officer Captain Cerasus Ehllo. When Sana, who Aryssha referred to as "Sanisi," visited the Starros homeworld of Hosnian Prime on one occasion following a bad breakup Aryssha was pregnant with twins and was due to give birth any day.

Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy
